Independent of OEM collection. State changes quickly; wear changes slowly. Missing SOH or cycles remain unavailable. Reading files cannot grant additional permissions.
Measures this application while monitoring is active. CPU, memory, UID traffic and operation durations explain agent overhead. Battery readings always describe the whole device.

Sampling follows the screen-off policy. Debug sampling expires automatically and does not enable verbose logs. History uses the common retention period (14 days by default). Self history has a separate budget inside the total storage limit.

Uses the common OTLP switch and endpoint. No network requests when OTLP is off. Queue retention is measured from creation; packets also get at least one hour after their due time. Retries do not extend expiry; the byte limit still applies. Android can delay background delivery.
Values show their actual observation time and source. Self statistics appear after an aggregation window or Stop. Historical values remain visible when collection is disabled.
Enable at least one collector before starting monitoring.
